title: Comfort Club Tune-Up Appointment Terms: Notice, Forfeiture and Missed-Appointment Fee
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements set three appointment terms per tier for booked tune-ups: the notice needed to reschedule or cancel, whether a missed or late-cancelled tune-up uses up the visit, and the missed-appointment fee on tiers that forfeit the visit.

| Tier | Notice to cancel or reschedule (elapsed hours before the arrival window starts) | Missed or late-cancelled tune-up uses up the visit | Missed-appointment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 24 | Yes | 35.00 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 24 | Yes | 35.00 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 24 | Yes | 25.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 24 | No | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 24 | No | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 24 | No | 0.00 |

## Meaning of the terms

- **Notice**: the elapsed hours before the start of the booked arrival window by which a tune-up must be cancelled or rescheduled to avoid forfeiture — 24 hours on every tier.
- **Uses up the visit**: whether a missed or late-cancelled tune-up counts against the visits of the term.
- **Missed-appointment fee**: the fee for a tune-up missed or cancelled late on a tier that forfeits the visit; 0.00 means none.

## Tier groups

| Group | Tiers | Forfeits the visit | Fee schedule figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Forfeiting tiers | Comfort Club Basic, Comfort Club Silver, Comfort Club Gold | Yes | 35.00, 35.00 and 25.00 |
| Non-forfeiting tiers | Comfort Club Platinum, Comfort Club Platinum Plus, Comfort Club Total Home | No | 0.00 |
